releases.notes:
## What's new in v1.8.0

### New tower: Shotgun
- Replaced the Basic tower with a **Shotgun tower** that fires a spread of 3 arrows simultaneously
- Uses a crossbow item in the shop; built from cobblestone, stone bricks and chiseled stone bricks
- Spread distance and stats are configurable (`SHOTGUN` key in tower config)

### Bug fixes
- **Mob pathfinding**: fixed mobs getting stuck or not reaching the nexus correctly
- **Arena hole**: fixed a gap in the arena floor that mobs could fall through
- **Minimap extra blocks**: the minimap now correctly renders solid blocks that aren't tracked as a named structure (walls, towers, etc.) — unregistered obstacles appear as neutral markers
- **Config sync on join**: server config is now pushed to clients when they join mid-game, ensuring consistent behaviour for late joiners
- **Spider spawner**: spider spawner recipe now correctly uses a spider eye item

### UI
- Locked shop buttons now display the tier label so players can see what they're unlocking before they can afford it

### Test suite
A full automated test suite was added and wired into the build:

- **ArcherTowerTests** — verifies the archer tower fires and damages a mob within range
- **MobMovementTests** — verifies mobs with `MoveToNexusGoal` pathfind toward the nexus
- **WallFireballTests** — verifies wall tier resistance (tier 1 = 1 hit, tier 2 = 2 hits, tier 3 = 3 hits) and that friendly fire does not damage own walls
- **GameManagerTests** — verifies game state transitions (lobby → prep → playing → idle)
- **WitchHealTests** — verifies witch aura heal behaviour, decay across consecutive cycles, and the witch-to-witch heal debuff

### CI
- New **CI workflow** runs unit tests and GameTest integration tests on every push to `main` and on pull requests
- Release workflow now runs tests first; the build-and-release job only proceeds if all tests pass

## What's new in 1.7.1

### Minimap improvements
- **Spawners and income generators** are now displayed on the minimap with distinct colors per team (purple/pink for spawners, gold/orange for generators)
- **Money display** added in the bottom-right corner — large and always visible at a glance
- **Wall height** restored to 4 blocks when placing walls during prep/play phase

### HUD / Sidebar
- Restored the **per-player scoreboard sidebar** that was missing since v1.7.0
- Sidebar now shows **"You"** and **"Opponent"** labels instead of generic "Player 1/2", tailored to each player's perspective

### Tower fixes
- Fixed **archer and basic towers shooting themselves** when a mob walks directly underneath — arrow origin is now offset 1 block horizontally toward the target at the correct height

### Shop / Economy
- Fixed **double payment bug** — placing a structure was charging the player twice (once per hand)

### Infrastructure
- Releases now **auto-publish to Modrinth** via GitHub Actions on every new tag

releases.notes:
## What's new in v1.7.0

### Minimap overhaul
- **4× larger** — the minimap is now 320×320px for a much clearer view of the arena
- **Live pathfinding** — dotted lines trace each mob's remaining path (green for yours, red for enemies)
- **Structures on the map** — walls (blue/orange), towers (darker blue/orange) and nexuses (cyan/pink) are all rendered

### UI & UX
- Boss bars now always say **"Your Nexus"** and **"Opponent's Nexus"** — no more "Player 1 / Player 2" confusion
- Same wording applied consistently throughout the HUD scoreboard

### New buying system
- **Pay when you place, not when you buy** — money is deducted only at the moment the block is placed in the world. If you can't afford it, the block is returned to your inventory
- **Add / Pick** — the old x1 / x5 / MAX buttons are gone:
  - **Add** — puts one copy of the item into the first empty hotbar slot
  - **Pick** — replaces your currently held item (unless it's a pickaxe or sword)
- **Non-stackable blocks** — each inventory slot holds exactly one purchasable block
- **Price in item name** — the cost is embedded in the item's display name (e.g. *Basic Tower ($10)*)
- **Price in stats column** — shown next to the DMG / HP / income stats in the shop

> ⚠️ **Important:** Make sure both your **client** and **server** are updated to this same JAR. Running mixed versions (old server + new client) will cause a client disconnect due to the expanded minimap packet format.

---
*Requires Fabric Loader 0.16.9+ and Minecraft 1.21.4*

## What's new in v1.6.0

### Nexus HP at the top of the screen
Two boss bars now permanently sit at the top of the screen for every player in the game — one for each team's nexus. The bar color updates live as HP changes: **green** above 60%, **yellow** above 30%, **red** below. Each bar shows the exact HP value (`Nexus 1: 72/100`), so you always know the state of both nexuses at a glance without opening the scoreboard.

### Minimap
A small 80×80 px arena overview appears in the **top-right corner**. It shows:
- **Green dots** — your own team's mobs currently on the map
- **Red dots** — enemy mobs
- A faint white line at the midline separating the two halves

The minimap refreshes every 10 ticks (~0.5 s) so mob positions stay accurate. It only renders while a game is active.

### Always full food and health
Player food level and health are silently restored to max every 3 seconds during the game. Hunger and incidental damage no longer slow you down or drain your food bar mid-build.

### Balance adjustments
- **Starting money**: 100 → 200 — gives a slightly more comfortable opening while still requiring prioritization
- **Baby Zombie**: HP 8 → 5, nexus damage 3 → 1 — the cheapest tier-2 mob was punching above its weight

### Config migration
Existing `towerdefense.json` files are automatically updated to the new Baby Zombie and starting money defaults on first load.

## What's new in v1.5.0

### Economy rebalance
The economy was too fast — players could snowball quickly with minimal risk. This patch slows everything down to make each gold piece matter.

- **Starting money**: 500 → 100
- **Generator income**: Basic 2→1 / Advanced 5→2 / Elite 15→7 per 10 s
- **Mob kill rewards** halved across all mob types
- **Ore spawns** yield roughly half as much gold (phases: ~7 / ~20 / ~37, down from ~15 / ~40 / ~75)

### Ravager nerf
The ravager was too oppressive — fast, tanky, and dealing massive nexus damage on top of breaching walls. Toned down while keeping the threat meaningful.

- Speed: 0.15 → 0.12
- Nexus damage: 20 → 12

### Basic tower nerf
- Damage: 2 → 1 — the cheapest option shouldn't outscale mid-tier towers at high upgrade levels

### Tower tooltips
Hovering any tower buy button now shows what it does. Useful for new players and when comparing options mid-game:

| Tower | Effect |
|---|---|
| Basic | Single target, no special |
| Archer | Long range, faster fire rate |
| Cannon | High damage, slow reload, splash |
| Laser | Very long range, high DPS |
| Fire | Burns mobs on hit (DoT) |
| Slow | Applies Slowness, no direct damage |
| Poison | Poisons mobs on hit (DoT) |
| Sniper | Extreme range/damage, very slow reload |
| Chain Lightning | Chains to nearby mobs after primary hit |
| AOE | Damages all mobs around the target |

### Config migration
Existing `towerdefense.json` files are automatically updated to the new defaults on first load — no manual editing needed.
